title: Scheduled reports
subtitle: Receive YouTube analytics automatically for selected channels. Completed reports are saved here.
name: Schedule name
channelsHelp: Enter each @handle, UC… channel ID, or youtube.com/@handle /channel/ID link on a new line. A separate report is created for each channel.
channelsOnePerLine: Enter each channel on a new line, without spaces.
invalidChannels: Use @handles, UC… channel IDs, or youtube.com/@handle /channel/ID links.
periodHelp: Reports cover the completed days before the scheduled date. Monthly reports are generated on the first of the month for the entire previous calendar month.
quotaHelp: Each new report for one channel uses one credit from your plan's daily YouTube analytics limit. Viewing saved reports does not use credits.
websiteHelp: Reports remain available on the website whether Telegram delivery is enabled or not.
botHelp: Link your Telegram bot account and enable notifications in bot settings to receive reports.
botExportsHelp: Enable report notifications in bot settings. Until then, reports are saved on the website.
created: Schedule created. Reports will appear after the first run.
queued: Report generation queued. The results will appear in history.
error: Unable to load or update reports. Please try again.
limitReached: The schedule limit has been reached. Delete a schedule to add another.
emptySchedules: Create a schedule to collect analytics automatically.
confirmDelete: Delete this schedule? Automatic generation will stop. Saved reports will remain available.
emptyHistory: No reports yet. Wait for the scheduled run or select Generate now.
reportFailed: This report could not be generated. Check the channel availability and generate it again.
dataHelp: Reports cover videos published during the selected period. Views, likes, and comments are their cumulative public counts at the time the report is generated.
